summary: Frontend-only regression test for SafetyProtocol MobileStage fix (video with poster fallback). Mobile viewport 390x844: all 3 mobile cards [protocol-stage-01/02/03-mobile] now render <video autoPlay muted playsInline loop preload='auto'> WITH poster attribute (Unsplash car images). Previously mobile was pure black. Screenshot confirms Stage 01 now shows car poster image visible. Desktop 1440x900 regression: all 3 sticky stages [protocol-stage-01/02/03] have <video> with autoplay/muted/poster/source — no regression. Gallery section present. Zero .error elements on page. Zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: In headless Chromium the mobile <video> elements did not actually start playback (currentTime stayed at 0, paused=true, readyState=0 after 3s wait) despite muted+playsInline+autoPlay+preload='auto'. However the poster attribute IS rendered natively by the video element, so users see the car image not black. On real iOS Safari / Android Chrome muted+playsInline autoplay is supported and should play. Recommend verifying manually on a real device or via a lighter poster-preload strategy if playback is critical.
MobileStage relies on Framer Motion useInView with margin '-15%' & once:true — cards below the fold don't animate until scrolled. Fine, works as designed.
STAGES_FALLBACK only has one entry (n:01) — if API returns empty stages array, only Stage 01 renders. Not a bug for current test (API returns 3 stages) but note as edge case.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SafetyProtocol MobileStage now correctly renders
